prayerExcerpt.en-US: Pour into our hearts, O Lord, the Holy Spirit.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Derramai, Senhor, em nossos corações, o Espírito Santo.

meta.face: A small, slight Syrian man of about sixty with an olive-brown complexion and a short, compact face — a broad, low forehead with fine lines, a short, blunt nose with a small hook, large, dark, luminous, deep-set eyes under thin arching brows, flat, lean cheeks, a small, soft chin and a wide, thin-lipped mouth; only a few wisps of grey hair at the temples under the hood, a sparse grey moustache and a thin wisp of beard at the chin (beardless by nature), and a rapt, singing look lifted toward the light.
meta.basis: Dionysius's Painter's Manual describes him as an old man with sparse hair and little beard, wearing a mantle; the Syriac icons show him in a black monk's hood writing his hymns. The olive complexion follows his birth at Nisibis.
